svg.title: NET-10-E — Empty session browser
svg.desc: NET-10-empty. Successful zero-row read; reason blank, Join selected disabled, upper Refresh focused. Canvas origin (25,20); SVG uses the top-left origin. Production bottom-left: unchanged Browse panel (24,24), 802 by 544; body edges inset 8 px from the outer frame, with 4 px clear inside the bevel when focused. Heading (32,490), 786 by 20; white list (32,248), 786 by 242; detail border (32,108), 786 by 128, retaining 8 px inner padding and 12 px list separation. No cached metadata or removed static captions. Footer: (32,32), (300,32), (568,32), each 250 by 32 with 18 px gaps. Conditional paging uses y=72 and is hidden here. Refresh (706,518), 112 by 24, moves left 4 px only. Preserve complete inline status under UX-NET-10-037, title chrome, text size, hidden-input rules, focus/traversal, discovery and joining behavior.

g.text: No active sessions listed. You can host a session or connect directly.
Retained six-column heading strip; empty white body with one full noninteractive status line.
Join selected disabled. Refresh focused. Direct connect remains independent.
No rows, body dividers, scrollbar, selection, hover, or focus. Colors: UX-NET-10-037.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; hide paging if neither direction exists.
